name: Mark of Prey
source:
In his final year of studying sound engineering, a young weasel named Felix finds himself jaded, with his future in his UK Midlands city uncertain. He truly believed that voluntarily railroading himself into university would solve the problems adulthood is likely to bring. Instead, it’s left him uncertain, isolated from his peers, and with almost no time to make these years of debt worth it all.

This feedback loop of indifference is severed when a wolf with less subtlety than sense grips him with the promise of the work experience he so desperately needs. He is pulled into the messy reality of a metal band that believes it's on the verge of something big. Now Felix faces a world that is louder, darker, and far more alive than before. But this isn’t a solo act, far from it!
